QUOTE: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`) carves allocations out of a caller-supplied buffer. It works by calling `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` with its own functions
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the buffer allocator's init function installing its own functions via the runtime setter, and says it is the one allocator the library ships. It never names MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C, but the mechanism and location are stated.
